parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging application.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the interactive messaging application.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of applications to return on each page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

*   0: ascending order by time
*   1: descending order by time

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live query-message-app --app-id VKL3000 --app-name testApp --sort-type 1 --page-num 10 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live QueryMessageApp --region cn-hangzhou --SortType 1 --AppId VKL3000 --PageNum 10 --PageSize 20 --AppName testApp
